title: Bug 642053: [master] [Sustainability] Preview Posting Creates Gaps in Sustainability Ledger Entry Numbers
summary: Preview posting of journal lines and documents that carry sustainability emissions no longer leaves gaps in Sustainability Ledger Entry numbers. Preview rows are now collected in memory under temporary numbers instead of being inserted, so no AutoIncrement identity is used. Normal posting is unchanged.
key_points: Preview posting collects sustainability ledger entries in memory instead of physically inserting them to avoid consuming AutoIncrement identity numbers
Adds interception logic to shared insert operation to redirect preview rows to temporary storage
Normal posting behavior remains unchanged and maintains sequential numbering
Comprehensive regression tests verify entry number continuity across journal types including general journal, purchase credit memo, recurring journals, and fixed asset journals
Multiple preview operations no longer burn entry numbers
quote: Preview no longer inserts real Sustainability Ledger Entries.
